bgSlug.label: Bulgarian URL address
bgSlug.help: The address segment for the Bulgarian page. Transliterate Bulgarian words using lowercase Latin letters, numbers, and hyphens.

enSlug.label: English URL address
enSlug.help: The English address segment. Turkish and Ukrainian addresses reuse this value. Use lowercase Latin letters, numbers, and hyphens.

parent.label: Parent category
parent.help: Where this category sits in the catalog tree.

name.label: Name
name.help: Shown in the tree, as the future page heading, and by default as the search-result title. Keep it clear and natural; about 50–60 characters is useful search guidance without keyword stuffing.

introduction.label: Introduction
introduction.help: Describes the category on the page itself and is shown to visitors. The meta description is a separate, more engaging text intended for search results.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.help: A short summary of the category. It may appear in Google or Bing below the SEO title and page address. Aim for about 140–160 clear characters; search engines may show different text.
metaDescription.example: Example for a “Solar panels” category: “Explore solar panels for homes and businesses and learn how to choose a suitable model based on output, efficiency, and your project’s needs.”

productTitleGuidance.label: Product-title guidance
productTitleGuidance.help: Internal guidance for authors naming products in this category; it is not public category copy.
productTitleGuidance.example: Example: “Write the title in this order: brand and model, power, product type—for example, [Brand] [Model] 440 W monocrystalline solar panel. Do not use promotional words such as ‘best’.”

specifications.emptyDescription: Add a characteristic that can later be filled in for products in this category.
specifications.languageHelp: The selected language controls the names of every specification and option below. All four languages are required before saving.

preview.title: Characteristics
preview.description: This is how the section would look in a real product listing. Names and options update from your current edits.

name.label: Name
name.help: The name shown beside the value in the product characteristics.

type.label: Type
type.help: Choose whether the value is text, a number, yes/no, or one of several options.

unit.label: Unit
unit.help: Optional unit for a numeric value, for example W, kW, or kg.

required.label: Required
required.help: A product must have a value for this specification before it can be published.

filterable.label: Use as a filter
filterable.help: Allows visitors to filter products by this specification.

specifications.optionsHelp: Add the prepared values an administrator can choose from when creating a product.

optionName.label: Option name
optionName.help: The value an administrator selects and a visitor sees in the characteristics.

specifications.confirmClearOptions: Changing type will remove all selection options. Continue?
